Recommendation — not company policy: I reached my tool-call limit for this turn; here is what I established before stopping.

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date. It is the only training with a hard deadline shorter than 30 days, because system access is granted on day one and the risk starts with it.

The full required set for every employee is: security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption. All four are completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends. Enrolling early means the elections are in place when eligibility arrives.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. An employee has 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one. The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

Every employee is issued a standard laptop configured for their role, a power adapter, a headset and a laptop bag. Fully remote employees receive a monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock at their home workspace, shipped before their start date.

Recommendation — not company policy: Coordinate with your manager and People Operations to ensure all onboarding steps are tracked in MosaicOne Onboarding, as the hiring manager is accountable for manager-owned items and People Operations chases when something slips.

Next steps:
- Complete security and acceptable-use training within 14 days of start date
- Complete all four required trainings (security, data protection, anti-harassment, anti-bribery) within 30 days
- Enrol in benefits in week one; make elections within 30 days of the 90-day waiting period end date
- Begin 401(k) contributions from first payroll run
- Confirm device setup (laptop, peripherals, headset) is shipped before start date

You meet the tenure requirement: employees must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside their home country. Your tenure is 45 months as of 2026-09-01.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your proposed stay is 42 consecutive calendar days (3 November to 14 December, inclusive). Stays exceeding 30 consecutive days require a Tax & Legal review before travel begins, director approval (not just manager approval), and the review must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure.

No employee may work outside their home country for more than 90 days in a rolling 12-month period. Your 42-day stay must fit within this annual limit.

Work performed outside your home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. Personal devices may not be used for any Mosaic Robotics work outside your home country.

Recommendation — not company policy: Notify IT Security of your Berlin destination at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

Escalation: Your request requires director approval and a Tax & Legal review. Raise the request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates (3 November – 14 December 2026) and workspace address at least 21 calendar days before departure. Contact People Operations at mobility@mosaicrobotics.example if you have questions about the approval process.

Next steps:
- Confirm your travel laptop is company-managed, full-disk-encrypted and configured with always-on VPN.
- File the Tax & Legal review request in MosaicOne by 13 October 2026 (21 days before 3 November).
- Obtain written director approval (not just manager approval) before departure.
- Notify IT Security of your Berlin destination by 27 October 2026 (5 business days before departure).

Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, so that a team's onsite days overlap and the office time is actually collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with your manager

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

Basic life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment cover begin when the medical waiting period ends.

Retirement plan eligibility is different and shorter: an employee may begin contributing to the 401(k) plan from their first payroll run, with no waiting period at all.

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations at benefits@mosaicrobotics.example if you have questions about your specific eligibility date or waiting period.
